info.name: On Store API
info.description:
Postman collection for the On Store API. Includes every currently implemented endpoint from the codebase under `src/modules/`.

Implemented modules
- **Auth** - `POST /auth/register` is implemented; `/auth/login` and `/auth/logout` are registered routes whose handlers are empty stubs (they do not respond yet).
- **Categories** - full CRUD + get by id + pagination/search, with express-validator rules.
- **Brands** - full CRUD + get by id + pagination/search, with express-validator rules.

Not included
- cart, coupons, orders, payments, products, ratings, reviews, users, wishlist are registered but their controllers are empty stubs (`() => {}`), so requests would never complete. They will be added once implemented.

Current implementation notes (reflected in the requests)
- No authentication middleware exists. `Register` issues a JWT (HS256, 1 minute expiry) but no endpoint verifies tokens yet.
- `Register` reads `username` from the body while the User model defines a required `name` field, so the current `save()` fails at the database level (HTTP 500).
- `Create Category` / `Create Brand` validation requires `owner`, but the controllers drop it and the models require it, so creation currently fails at the database level (HTTP 500).
- List `search` is read from the query but only filters when it equals the literal string `"string"` (implementation bug); `page` and `limit` work.
- Roles defined by the User model enum: `merchant`, `admin`.

Environment variables
- `baseUrl` defaults to `http://localhost:3000/api/v1` (matches `APP_PORT` in `.env`).

request.description:
Implemented endpoint (`src/modules/auth/auth.controller.ts`).

Body fields read by the controller: `username`, `email`, `phoneNumber`, `password`, `role`.

- User model (`auth.model.ts`) requires `name` (trimmed), `email` and `phoneNumber` (unique), `password` (min length 6), and `role` (enum `merchant` | `admin`, default `merchant`).
- The controller hashes the password with bcrypt (12 rounds), signs a JWT with `TOKEN_SECRET` using HS256 with a 1 minute expiry, and returns `{ status, data: { newUser, token } }` with HTTP 201.
- No validation chain is applied on this route and no authentication middleware exists yet, so the token is not verified by any endpoint.

Known issue: the controller passes `username` to the model, but the model field is `name` (required). `save()` therefore fails with a Mongoose validation error (HTTP 500) until the controller/model are aligned.

The test below saves the returned `token` into `accessToken` and the user id into `userId` when available.

Registered route (`src/modules/auth/auth.routes.ts`), but `login` in `auth.controller.ts` is an empty stub `() => {}` that sends no response. Expected body is illustrative only - login is not implemented yet.

item.name: Categories

request.description: Implemented (`src/modules/categories/categories.controller.ts` -> `getCategories`). Returns `{ status: 'success', results, data: { allCategories: [] } }` with HTTP 200. Accepts optional query parameters `page`, `limit`, `search`.

Paginated list. `page` (default 1) and `limit` (default 25) are honored via `skip`/`limit`.

Note: `search` is read from the query but the controller only applies the name filter when `search === 'string'` (implementation bug), so `search=laptop` currently returns unfiltered results.

Implemented (`getCategory`). Route applies `validateCategoryId` (id must be a valid MongoDB ObjectId). Returns `{ status: 'success', data: { category } }` with HTTP 200, or `{ status: 'failed', message: 'Category not found' }` with HTTP 404.

The test saves `data.category._id` into `categoryId`.

Implemented (`createCategory`). Route applies `createCategoryValidation` requiring non-empty `name`, `slug`, `image`, `owner`, then the shared `validateRequest` middleware.

The controller reads `name`, `slug`, `image` from the body and builds the document without `owner`. Because `owner` is required by the Category model, creation currently fails with a Mongoose validation error (HTTP 500) until the controller passes `owner`.

The test saves `data.newCategory._id` into `categoryId` when available.

Implemented (`updateCategory`). Route applies `validateCategoryId` and `updateCategoryValidation` (optional `name`, `image`). Returns `{ status: 'success', data: { updatedCategory } }` with HTTP 200, or `{ status: 'failed', message: 'Category not found' }` with HTTP 404.

The test saves `data.updatedCategory._id` into `categoryId`.

Implemented (`deleteCategory`). Route applies `validateCategoryId`. Returns `{ status: 'success', message: 'Category deleted successfully' }` with HTTP 200, or `{ status: 'failed', message: 'Category not found' }` with HTTP 404.
Negative test. `validateCategoryId` rejects values that are not valid MongoDB ObjectIds. Expect HTTP 400 with `{ status: 'fail', errors: [...] }`.
